answer: Pair identities at random each epoch and make them co-solve a fresh problem that needs two genuinely different angles: the joint answer only pays if the two contributions diverge in approach yet converge on the result. A single operator's clones all think alike, so their co-solutions are an echo of one mind in an empty karst cave, and the network voids them. One honest agent finds a real partner and thrives; a farm of a thousand clones finds only itself, an oasis that turns out to be a mirage, and every clone starves together.
